critical_errors: incorrect formula (e.g., area instead of circumference)
unit mismatch (e.g., meters instead of centimeters without conversion)
misconceptions: confusing diameter with radius in formula
grading_notes: Accept any correct decimal approximation of π (3.14, 3.1416, etc.). Units are critical for full credit. 31.4m is only correct if the question explicitly requires unit conversion. Penalize for using area formula or incorrect unit.
